aprs.fi high-resolution APRS symbol set by Heikki Hannikainen, OH7LZB
Source: https://github.com/hessu/aprs-symbols/ (released for free use by any APRS
application; per-symbol licensing is documented in COPYRIGHT.md, shipped alongside).

Only the 24 px @2x sprite sheets (48x48 per symbol, 16 columns x 6 rows, starting at
ASCII 33) are vendored: -0 primary table, -1 secondary table, -2 overlay characters.
